AI Trial Rotator

Keep premium AI models alive on free trials · Built by ylivo4real 👾

What this is

A production multi-provider free-trial rotator and session manager.
Cycle accounts across Grok, Claude, GPT, Gemini and more so you never hit a paywall.

Full Source

Complete working codebase (backend + React dashboard + encrypted account store) is on GitHub:

https://github.com/nagatoara4/ai-trial-rotator

Quick Start

git clone https://github.com/nagatoara4/ai-trial-rotator.git
cd ai-trial-rotator && npm install
cp .env.example .env
npm run dev

Dashboard → http://localhost:3000
API → http://localhost:3001

Features

• Multi-provider account farm (Grok, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini…)
• Encrypted local session store
• Smart rotation when quota / trial dies
• Clean React dashboard
• Proxy & fingerprint ready
• MIT licensed — free to use, sell, teach
